integrity: Combines credited classical matrix-valued Nevanlinna--Pick and numerical-radius inequalities with an exact sharpness family using matrix singular values and scalar Schwarz--Pick. Supplementary exact rational checker is not a replacement for analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Universal quantitative factor-two estimate holds for arbitrary finite distinct disk nodes and complex square-matrix targets; sharpness is shown using two nodes with 2x2 nilpotent targets. The exact finite-separation true interpolation cost is bounded rather than calculated.
title: The optimal factor-two guarantee for numerical-radius Pick interpolation and its sharp collision defect
